_note: Allow-list for text-vs-line/bar bounding-box overlaps that check_text_overlaps.mjs would otherwise flag. Add entries when a chart deliberately places a text label on top of a line (e.g. an inline series label sitting on the line as a leader anchor). Each entry needs `page`, `text`, `reason`. `page` is the URL path (e.g. /inflation/). `text` is the literal text content of the <text> element. Match is case-sensitive, full-string. A blank text matches a text element whose text content is empty.
